objects.description: [Rover](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0090) persists by creating a Registry entry in HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\.(Citation: Palo Alto Rover)
objects.description_fa: [Rover](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0090) با ایجاد یک ورودی رجیستری در HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\ ادامه می‌یابد.(Citation: Palo Alto Rover)
